question.text: Which of the following correctly reflects Goals 1, 5 and 13 of the UN 2030 Agenda?

answer.text: Goal 1: No Poverty; Goal 5: Gender Equality; Goal 13: Climate Action
Goal 1: Zero Hunger; Goal 5: Quality Education; Goal 13: Life Below Water
Goal 1: Good Health; Goal 5: Clean Water; Goal 13: Decent Work
Goal 1: Partnerships; Goal 5: Reduced Inequalities; Goal 13: Peace & Justice

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the 2030 Agenda: Goal 1 is No Poverty, Goal 5 is Gender Equality, Goal 13 is Climate Action. India records its lowest performance on SDG 1 (No Poverty), SDG 2 (Zero Hunger), and SDG 5 (Gender Equality) per the SDG India Index 2020-21. The Trap: Options B, C and D mix up the SDG numbering. A common pitfall is to confuse SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) with SDG 1 or swap SDG 13 (Climate Action) with SDG 14 (Life Below Water). Cross-Exam Context: Cross-links to Topic 4 (Logic Model) where SDGs anchor impact-path statements and Ch 6 (Frameworks). SIAs cite SDG numbers in the AIR narrative — wrong numbering is an error of attribution. Assessor's Pro-Tip: When drafting the AIR, tag each output to an SDG code (e.g., 'SDG 5.5 — women's participation in leadership'). This creates an audit trail that reviewers and SSE auditors can verify against the SDG Indicators framework.
